findings.description: Auth enablement should commit to Option A (seed fake token cache) rather than defer Option A vs B. build_cached_headers -> auth.copilot_token(force_refresh=false) returns the cached token with NO network when expires_at > now+60 (header_source.rs:89-97, auth.rs:170-177), so a future-expiring seeded token avoids any live exchange and any production edit.
findings.resolution: Plan now commits to Option A as the approach (with the source proof in Technical Constraints #2 and Approach), demotes Option B to a fallback used only if the fixture/preflight is infeasible.

findings.description: Option A must seed COPILOT_API_HOME (AppPaths::from_env reads it, paths.rs:15; fallback ~/.local/share/copilot-api), NOT CODEX_HOME. Seeding the wrong env fails to satisfy auth and risks reading the developer's real Copilot cache.
findings.resolution: Plan corrected to set+restore COPILOT_API_HOME to a temp dir and seed copilot_token there (Approach, Risk #1, US-002 strategy, AC).

findings.description: The mock must mount POST /v1/chat/completions, not /chat/completions: TestCodexBuilder sets provider base_url to {server}/v1 (test_codex.rs:364) and send_chat_request appends /chat/completions (chat_completions.rs:31). Wrong path = test silently matches nothing.
findings.resolution: Plan updated to mount /v1/chat/completions (or override config.model_provider.base_url) across Approach, Files, Risk, AC, Scope.

findings.description: Chat-route model setup is load-bearing, not an open question: the e2e must set a ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions model via with_model_info_override(...) plus install_anthropic_gate(true), else client.rs:1632 routes through Responses and the chat path never runs.
findings.resolution: Promoted into US-003 strategy + AC + Risk as a concrete setup step (with_model_info_override + install_anthropic_gate(true)); Open Question #4 now only asks for the exact slug + override mechanism confirmation.

findings.description: The network-gated full-loop e2e has no autonomously-verifiable in-loop gate (sandbox disables localhost TCP -> skip_if_no_network; gim-home CI org-policy-blocked). The most important assertions could be marked done without running.
findings.resolution: Added a 'Verifiability layering' principle: central assertions are made verifiable WITHOUT network (US-001, the gated ACs via build_chat_request_body + parser tests); the wiremock multi-turn loop is a network-gated capstone (US-003) run outside the sandbox with pasted evidence, not the sole gate for any AC. Decomposition re-ordered (US-001 first).

findings.description: The per-item byte-cap test (build_chat_body_caps_oversized_replayed_reasoning, payload.rs:856) and the absent-effort test (payload.rs:744) already exist; strengthen them (exact tail/boundary) rather than adding duplicates.
findings.resolution: US-001 strategy + AC reworded to STRENGTHEN the named existing tests (:856 exact tail, :744/:729 effort, :767/:800 replay), no duplicates.

findings.sectionRef: Files to Create > leaf test crate dev-deps
findings.description: The leaf crate is specified to dev-depend on core_test_support, but core_test_support has no workspace key and codex-invariant-tests (the cited precedent) does not dev-depend on it; the overlay->core_test_support path is unproven and load-bearing.
findings.resolution: Added a US-002 PREFLIGHT (cargo metadata/trial manifest) to confirm core_test_support is nameable from the overlay leaf crate before building US-003; recorded as a Risk and an AC; fallback (core/tests/suite/) documented and gated on the preflight in Open Question #3.

findings.description: 'Same-chunk ordering confirmed via existing test' is not verifiable unless it names the exact test + command. 'reasoning_effort-absent (or gate-off) negative guard' is ambiguous and partly redundant (absent-effort test exists; gate-off is awkward with a process-global gate).
findings.resolution: AC now cites single_read_with_reasoning_and_content_keeps_reasoning_first (chat_transport.rs:1096) by name + the just test -p command; dropped 'gate-off' and kept a single concrete absent/present-effort requirement (:744/:729).

findings.description: US-001 as a standalone production-facing 'enablement' story risks unnecessary chat_transport.rs production changes; the cache-seeding fixture belongs with the e2e fixture, not a separate seam.
findings.resolution: Restructured: US-001 is now the no-network deterministic assertions (no production change); the COPILOT_API_HOME token-cache fixture lives WITH the e2e in US-002 (test-only), not a standalone production seam.

findings.description: Dep/dev-dep labeling imprecision: anyhow/codex-client/reqwest/serde/tokio are regular [dependencies], only wiremock/tempfile/pretty_assertions are [dev-dependencies]. The cycle conclusion itself is correct.
findings.resolution: Constraint #1 corrected to label regular deps vs dev-deps accurately, with the verified cycle citations (core/Cargo.toml:36, core/tests/common/Cargo.toml:20).

findings.sectionRef: Files to Create > leaf crate dev-deps
findings.description: The leaf crate Cargo.toml dep list is incomplete for the US-003 setup: the e2e calls codex_model_provider::install_anthropic_gate and uses codex_protocol::openai_models::ModelWireRoute (to set ModelInfo.wire_route via test_codex.rs:283), neither of which was listed.
findings.resolution: Added codex-model-provider and codex-protocol to the leaf crate dev-deps (Files, US-002 AC, stories-outline), with codex-features noted only if the config-feature gate path is used.

findings.description: Gate ordering trap: config/mod.rs:2832 re-derives the gate from Feature::AnthropicModels during test_codex().build(), so install_anthropic_gate(true) called BEFORE build() is silently reset to false and chat_transport.rs:64-75 routes the chat-hinted model back through Responses (the /v1/chat/completions mock never fires).
findings.resolution: Pinned the ordering in US-003 strategy + Risk + AC + stories-outline: enable Feature::AnthropicModels in the builder config before build(), OR call install_anthropic_gate(true) AFTER build() and before the first submitted turn (never before build()).
